name: Document Spotlight
description: A document set in real type (its kind as a kicker, the headline in Source Serif, the narration's sentence as its body) lands on a dark desk; the camera pushes in and leans toward the key words, a hand-drawn loop circles them (frame 30 -> 52; a phrase over two lines gets a hand underline per line) and a callout with a leader line names them (frame 54). For a report, records, a study, a newspaper or a law the line cites.

sample.text: Lake Powell's water fell to its lowest level since it first filled
sample.label: Report
sample.subtitle: Bureau of Reclamation
sample.body: The bureau's data show the reservoir fell to its lowest level since it first filled in 1980.
sample.highlight: lowest level since it first filled

name: Photo Focus
description: The still fills the frame; from frame 10 the camera eases in on its subject (a reviewed anchor, else the frame's centre), the edges fall back into shade, a hand-drawn ring circles the subject (frame 34 -> 56) and a callout with a leader line names it (frame 54) when the line names it.

name: Graph Build
description: The line's own figures on dark glass: three or more years as a line that draws in (frames 12 -> 60, cubic in-out) with its area filling behind, each point popping and its value counting up as the line reaches it, the last point ringed with the change since the first; other figures as bars growing in turn, the largest in the accent and ringed. Title and unit above.

name: Map Path
description: Two places on a dark vector map (the states, else the countries): the camera starts close on the first, pin and name, and travels out to a view of both (frames 8 -> 52) while the route draws along the great circle (frames 20 -> 62) with a soft glow and a bright head; the second pin lands as the route arrives, then its name and the distance (as said, else straight-line miles).

name: Number Reveal
description: One figure, big and low on the footage over a feathered shade: what it counts in small tracked caps in the accent, the number counting up in Anton with tabular figures (frames 6 -> 40), its unit beside it, an accent rule drawing under it and one line of what it means (subtitle). Left, or right with align.

sample.subtitle: above sea level, the lowest since 1963
